items.title: EU vies to expand role in Ukraine-Russia peace talks to influence US thinking
items.why: Shows how Brussels is trying to stop a US–Russia deal being made over its head, with the Abu Dhabi timing and Moscow's conditions.

items.title: Von der Leyen: a magyar változásokkal Európa is erősebb lett
items.why: Shows how the EU is rewarding [[p:Péter Magyar]]'s reforms with funds, in the same week Budapest held back Ukraine's next clusters.

items.title: With Kyiv's air defense crews as they race to keep up with Russia's jet-powered drones
items.why: Ground-level reporting on why fast jet Shaheds beat Kyiv's layered air defence, and what interceptors are coming.

items.title: Can the US still deter Russia? Lithuania navigates an uneasy alliance
items.why: On-record views from Vilnius on hedging against Washington while seeking permanent US troops; analysis.

items.title: New electronics reach Iran, but prices soar as gov't fees, US sanctions hit
items.why: A reporter in Tehran shows how the blockade and the UAE trade halt reach shop counters: smuggling through Sulaimaniyah, import duties of up to 30%, and a minimum wage of about $83 a month with the rial near 2.64 million per dollar.

items.title: הפעם אנחנו יודעים (This time we know)
items.why: Israel's senior columnist, writing on election eve, sets out what each outcome would mean for war, the judiciary and Arab citizens. He reveals that army chiefs Halevi and Zamir demanded Netanyahu's orders in writing, and argues the opposition should merge after the vote. This is opinion.
